summary: Alamos Gold Inc. filed a Form 6-K providing notice of its second quarter 2026 financial results release and conference call. The press release announces that results will be issued after market close on July 29, 2026, with a conference call on July 30, 2026. No transaction, merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is involved. This is a routine earnings notification with no special-situation corporate action.
